All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked T1 and T4 by hand against the data. I did not check T11 or T13 by hand.

Three results to be aware of:
- **T3 and T10:** qlang prints map keys as keywords, so T10's answer shows `:db`, `:api` and `:worker`. T3's keys are strings, but the printed form may differ in the same way.
- **T5:** `distinct` answers a set, but the following `sort` turns it back into a vector.
- **T13:** it returns Birch at 109.97 and Acme at 104.96.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy ~(/) | * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/) | * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | * (coalesce {}) | * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | print | drop 1) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | * count
T11: lines | * (split " ") | * (filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) | * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | * {:c /1 :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/c) | * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc)]) | take 2 | * {:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total /1}
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
